verdict.rationale: Postman is a cloud SaaS API platform, so user control over data retention and deletion is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, retention windows, or user-facing deletion or purge controls. Postman Vault (securing data) and request history are adjacent features, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
